dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-body region toward the posterior peduncle, terminating in a rounded tip.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical deviation on the left lateral margin (relative to camera orientation) mid-body; otherwise, edges are smooth and consistent with a streamlined profile.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Predominantly mature white with visible light-grey saturation, specifically around the blowhole and the posterior peduncle region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density of localized dark-pixel clusters concentrated around the anterior blowhole and along the midline of the posterior dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; smooth gradients are observed between the primary white surface and the residual grey pigmented areas near the dorsal ridge.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark transverse slit at the blowhole; multiple dark transverse linear marks visible on the posterior dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Series of transverse topological disruptions (creases or folds) visible along the central dorsal axis in the posterior third of the body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of dark, transverse linear markings on the posterior dorsal surface which may represent healed or active epidermal disruptions.
